Admissions
Preapplication Information Session (Online), TBD, USA and Canada Central Time
Please join us (staff and students) in an online Preapplication Information Session:
TBD (USA & Canada Central Time). This session will assist you with preparing the graduate
admission application. We will share some do’s and don’ts which may be helpful in
completing your application.
Meeting Link (Teams)
How to apply?
What do I need to submit to apply to the Chemistry Graduate Program?
Create online account with ApplyWeb
Complete online application
Three letters of recommendation. An email notification from our Graduate School will be sent directly to your recommenders.
Please clearly indicate their email addresses during the online application process.
You need to waive or decline to waive the confidentiality statement at the bottom
of the application.
Resume. List the most current institution even if you are not receiving a degree.
Statement of Purpose (SOP). Include your name on the form and indicate your interest of a research field.
Submission of GRE exam scores is encouraged but not required for application to the
graduate program. However if you would like to submit it, please request Educational
Testing Service (ETS) to send GRE General Test scores to the University of Houston Main Campus (ETS code 6870).
Request Educational Testing Service (ETS) to send GRE Chemistry or Physics Test scores to the University of Houston Main Campus (ETS code 6870). These tests are
optional but encouraged for consideration of fellowship awards.
Request Educational Testing Service (ETS) to send TOEFL scores to the University of Houston Main Campus (ETS code 6870). Required for international
students only. IELTS test results are also acceptable as proof of English proficiency.
Please review English Language Proficiency and Exemptions for more information.
The application is free for domestic students. The application fee is $80 for international students.
Send official transcripts/degree certificates to the UH Graduate School. See university requirements for international students. Official individual mark sheets in certain countries,
transcripts, and degree certificates must be sent directly to the Graduate School.
